subject.title: [Feature]: Add comparative cost windows to Usage

question: Should OpenClaw accept comparative Usage cost windows and daily chart scale labels in the Control UI now, most likely by reviewing and refreshing the linked implementation PR?
rationale: The code path is clear and current main lacks the feature, but this is a protected maintainer-labeled, user-visible dashboard change with an open dirty PR candidate, so automation cannot choose the product direction or merge path.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Refresh the linked PR onto current main, resolve conflicts, rerun exact-head Usage UI and gateway validation, then review it as the implementation path.

options.title: Request UI Shape Changes
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open but ask for specific changes to card placement, window coverage, wording, or visual treatment before acceptance.

options.title: Defer Or Decline
options.body: Leave this as backlog or close the paired work if maintainers decide the existing range presets and hover tooltips are sufficient for now.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Refresh the linked PR onto current main, resolve conflicts, rerun exact-head Usage UI and gateway validation, then review it as the implementation path.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the feature request and linked implementation candidate, making it the strongest available product-routing owner.
